topics.title_zh: 黄仁勋突遭董事会罢免叠加SEC调查：英伟达3.1万亿帝国陷治理危机
topics.title_en: Jensen Huang Ousted by Board Amid SEC Probe: Nvidia's $3.1T Empire in Turmoil
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达突发超级黑天鹅，董事会因诚信隐瞒问题罢免创始人黄仁勋，同时SEC对其会计实务立案调查。叠加股价连跌7周、纳指周跌10.4%，全球算力基建中枢遭遇前所未有的估值与治理重构动荡。
topics.summary_en: Nvidia faces an unprecedented crisis as its board unexpectedly removes founder Jensen Huang over integrity disclosures, while the SEC launches an accounting probe. Compounded by seven straight weekly stock losses, the AI hardware backbone confronts massive systemic re-evaluation.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 机构合规派 / 董事会代表
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 审计机构与激进机构投资者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 必须拆除建立在个人崇拜与财务黑盒上的算力泡沫，切除关联交易与信息瞒报脓包，唯有制度化透明审计才能支撑AI基础设施的长久存续。
perspective_pro.point_en: The compute bubble built on founder cult and financial opacity must be purged; transparent auditing and institutional governance are essential to sustain long-term AI infrastructure.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 算力连续性派 / 硬件极客派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 半导体资深分析师与系统工程主管
perspective_con.point_zh: 黄仁勋是CUDA软硬件帝国的真正灵魂，战时罢免掌舵人将重创算力路线图迭代节奏，官僚化合规反噬恐让英伟达在竞争白热化关头丧失战略进攻力。
perspective_con.point_en: Jensen Huang is the singular visionary behind CUDA and Silicon dominance; ousting him mid-war disrupts hardware roadmaps and paralyzes strategic execution in bureaucratic red tape.

topics.title_zh: TML发布Inkling 2 Mini：单Token循环3层以5.4B击穿27B推理性能
topics.title_en: Thinking Machines Launches Inkling 2 Mini: 3-Layer Token Loops Match 27B at 5.4B Active
topics.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab开源26.4B权重模型Inkling 2 Mini，通过每Token循环中间层3次的创新机制，以仅5.4B激活参数在智能评测上对齐Qwen3.8-27B，直接向盲目堆砌参数的粗放Scaling Law开炮。
topics.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab open-sourced Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B total/5.4B active), looping middle layers three times per token to match Qwen3.8-27B's reasoning performance, directly challenging brute-force parameter scaling paradigms.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 效率演进派 / 端侧部署先锋
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 开源轻量化研究员与端侧架构师
perspective_pro.point_zh: 以时间换空间彻底击破模型参数通胀！通过层级循环深挖单个Token的推理深度，让消费级笔记本跑赢庞大服务器集群，指明了模型瘦身的正统演进方向。
perspective_pro.point_en: Trading time for spatial efficiency halts parameter hyperinflation; recurrent layer loops extract deep reasoning per token, enabling consumer laptops to challenge power-hungry cloud clusters.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业吞吐派 / 显存瓶颈怀疑论者
perspective_con.role_en: 🔴 Serving Latency Realists & Scaled Infra Leads
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 大模型推理系统与算子优化专家
perspective_con.point_zh: 层循环实质是将KV Cache开销和时序延迟成倍放大，在长文本与高并发场景下计算拓扑将严重受阻，且深度循环容易诱发难以调试的语义振荡缺陷。
perspective_con.point_en: Recurrent layer loops severely multiply sequential latency and memory-bandwidth stalls; in high-concurrency production, recurrent iterations risk severe semantic oscillation and KV-cache bloat.

linked_news.title_zh: 人工分析称 Inkling 2 Mini 具有 5.4B 的活动参数，其智能指数与 Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) 相匹配，但活动参数少约 5 倍（人工分析）
linked_news.title_en: Artificial Analysis says Inkling 2 Mini, with 5.4B active parameters, matches Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) on its Intelligence Index with ~5x fewer active parameters (Artificial Analysis)

linked_news.title_zh: TML 发布了 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一个开放权重 26.4B 参数转换器，每个 token 循环中间层 3 次，以便用更少的 token 进行更好的推理（Thinking Machines La）
linked_news.title_en: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)

topics.title_zh: Gemini接管Mac后台遭遇Signal截屏封锁：端侧Agent攻入桌面隐私雷区
topics.title_en: Google Gemini Backdoor Mac Control Sparks Signal Screen Blackout Amid Agent Infiltration
topics.summary_zh: 谷歌为Mac端Gemini上线后台多任务接管功能，苹果亦加速自研类Muse系统智能体；另一端Signal火速在iOS/Android实施强制截屏封锁，端侧AI接管系统高权限与绝对用户隐私底线爆发正面冲突。
topics.summary_en: Google launched autonomous Mac background app execution for Gemini, while Apple accelerates its Muse-like OS agent. In response, Signal enforced total screenshot bans, igniting a war between agentic system takeover and cryptographic privacy bounds.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 全托管Agent派 / 系统自治先驱
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 端侧Agent产品团队与自动化开发者
perspective_pro.point_zh: AI必须从被动对话玩具跃迁为系统级操盘手，唯有赋予其在后台自主调用跨应用工作流的特权，个人生产力才能真正摆脱繁琐界面的束缚。
perspective_pro.point_en: AI must evolve beyond passive chatbots into proactive system controllers; granting cross-app background execution privileges is the prerequisite for liberating users from manual UI friction.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 零信任防线派 / 端到端加密捍卫者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 隐私安全学者与端加密应用核心开发者
perspective_con.point_zh: 赋予AI持续截屏与跨进程操控权限等同于在操作系统植入合法特洛伊木马，一旦多模态Agent遭指令注入，用户核心机密将在无感知中全盘裸奔外泄。
perspective_con.point_en: Granting persistent screenshot and desktop control privileges amounts to sanctioning a native trojan; a single prompt injection vulnerability leaves encrypted corporate and personal assets completely exposed.

苹果正在开发一款类似于 Meta 的 Muse 的新人工智能代理。

根据职位列表，人工智能代理将代表用户编写代码、浏览网页、控制应用程序和导航设备。
linked_tweets.content_en:
Apple reportedly is building a new AI agent similar to Meta’s Muse.

Apple recently posted new job listings on its website for various agentic AI engineers, according to Bloomberg.

The AI agent will write code, browse the web, control apps, and navigate devices on a user’s behalf, according to job listings.
